purpose: Second adversarial named-person completeness tranche: materialize additional high-confidence people exposed after broadening active, coordinated and titled-person detection and hardening sentence-boundary parsing.
identityRule: Promote only complete, high-confidence personal names in explicit human-role, legal/custody or remediation prose. Person nodes are neutral subject-of-record identities and never imply culpability, participation, protected status, actor role or governance.
explicitNonGoals: Do not infer responsibility, culpability, Material Participation, control, operation, supply, membership or any ECL outcome from a Person identity.
Do not treat victims, defendants, journalists, activists, opposition figures, former officials or other case subjects as adverse actors merely because they are named.
Do not materialize sentence fragments, governance headings, geographic labels, legal titles or institutional phrases that merely resemble personal names.
